## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New user feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactor with no feature change
- [ ] `test`: Added or updated unit/integration tests
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates

## Privacy & Safety Impact
- [ ] Does this change access location or user coordinates? (Must NOT track background location)
- [ ] Does this change affect the Friends vs. Public privacy boundary?
- [ ] Have privacy settings ("Keep my visits private") been respected?

## Verification & Testing
- [ ] Unit tests added / updated and passing (`npm test`)
- [ ] TypeScript compiles cleanly with zero errors (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Tested on iOS device / simulator frame
- [ ] Tested on Android device / simulator frame
- [ ] Offline resilience verified (no crash when disconnected)
